{{BossList|Default}} |ability1 = '''Swing''' - Swings its scythe in an obtuse arc, stunning towers and dealing damage to units caught in its' range. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' was the final boss of the second and third mission of [[The Classic Event]], and the first boss of the fifth mission in the same event. It had a high amount of health though it walked quite slowly. Additionally, as it was a [[Boss]] enemy, it had multiple immunities to prevent it from being stunned, frozen, confused, knocked back by any tower or slowed down by the [[DJ Booth]]. It was also immune to the slowdown from the [[Toxic Gunner]] and the fallout damage from the [[Nuke]]. However, no towers except the [[Freezer]] with its freeze applied such effects in [[The Classic Event]]. The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' could not be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode]] through normal means. Instead, you had to go to either [[Classic Winter]], [[Classic Island Chaos]] or [[Classic Castle]] through their [[Challenge Maps]] in the challenge tab, then spawn the modern [[Grave Digger]], and the '''Korblox Deathwalker''' will appear instead. It could not be affected by the [[Double Health]] and [[Boss (Modifier)|Boss]] modifiers, like all Korblox enemies. ==Appearance== The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' was a large ghostly figure which only has skeleton arms and parts of legs. Its torso was replaced by a giant flame and it had no head, only blue flaming eyes. It wore a brown hood with a cape that has four black wings attached to it. On its arms it had blue shoulder-pads and armbands with grey accents. It also had a brown belt with blue crystals and a brown cloth attached to the back of it. It wielded a large brown and grey scythe. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Classic Castle]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Accelerator]] are very effective against this. **Towers that fully or partially are immune to stuns, like the [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]] or [[Engineer]] can be very useful as they cannot get stunned. **In [[Classic Winter]], the [[Militant]] and [[Military Base]] perform quite well against it. *The [[Commander]] can be quite useful at boosting the firerate of your towers, if it is available. *While the [[Freezer]] could be used to slow down the '''Korblox Deathwalker''' in [[Classic Winter]], this is not necessary. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} KorbloxDeathwalkerFloat.gif|Walking animation (23 May 2024 – 12 March 2025) KorbloxDeathwalkerSwing.gif|''Swing'' animation (23 May 2024 – 12 March 2025) KorbloxDeathwalkerDeath.gif|Death animation (23 May 2024 – 12 March 2025) }} ==Trivia== *The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' model is taken from a bundle {{RLinkBU|319226|of the same name}}. *On the boss health bar icon, the '''Korblox Deathwalker's''' eyes did not appear. ==Update History== *'''23 May 2024''' -
